question: Build a peer comp table for four analog and mixed-signal semiconductor companies: Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Microchip Technology and NXP Semiconductors. Alignment rule: for each company use its own fiscal quarter that ended between April 1, 2026 and July 31, 2026 (inclusive); do not calendarize or move any company to a different quarter. Each company has exactly one such quarter. For that quarter report, using GAAP figures from the company's SEC filings as of October 3, 2026: (1) revenue in USD millions; (2) year-over-year revenue growth in % versus the same fiscal quarter a year earlier; (3) gross margin in % = gross profit / revenue; (4) operating margin in % = GAAP operating income / revenue. Also state the fiscal quarter label and quarter-end date used for each company.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Peer comp, each company's own fiscal quarter ending Apr 1-Jul 31, 2026 (GAAP):
| Row | Revenue | YoY revenue growth | Gross margin | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Texas Instruments (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-06-30) | 5,463.0 | 22.82% | 61.36% | 42.28% |
| Analog Devices (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-05-02) | 3,623.5 | 37.25% | 67.33% | 38.08% |
| Microchip Technology (Q1 FY2027, ended 2026-06-30) | 1,484.7 | 38.05% | 63.24% | 22.68% |
| NXP Semiconductors (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-06-28) | 3,496.0 | 19.48% | 57.27% | 30.64% |

output.answer:
All four companies' relevant quarters ended within the April 1–July 31, 2026 window. Here is the peer comp table using GAAP figures from each company's earnings release/SEC filings (TXN gross margin shown as gross profit/revenue; the figures tie to the income statements in each release).

## Analog & Mixed-Signal Semiconductor Peer Comp

| Company | Fiscal quarter label | Quarter-end date | Revenue (US$M) | YoY revenue growth | Gross margin | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Texas Instruments | Q2 2026 | June 30, 2026 | 5,463 | +22.8% | 61.4% | 42.3% |
| Analog Devices | Fiscal Q2 2026 | May 2, 2026 | 3,623 | +37.2% | 67.3% | 38.1% |
| Microchip Technology | Fiscal Q1 2027 | June 30, 2026 | 1,484.7 | +38.0% | 63.2% | 22.7% |
| NXP Semiconductors | Q2 2026 | June 28, 2026 | 3,496 | +19.5% | 57.3% | 30.6% |

## Supporting detail (revenue / gross profit / operating income; year-ago revenue)

- **Texas Instruments** — Q2 2026: revenue $5,463M; gross profit $3,352M; operating profit $2,310M. Year-ago (Q2 2025) revenue $4,448M. (1,015/4,448 = +22.8%; GM 3,352/5,463 = 61.4%; OM 2,310/5,463 = 42.3%)
- **Analog Devices** — Fiscal Q2 2026: revenue $3,623M; gross margin $2,440M (67.3%); operating income $1,380M (38.1%). Year-ago (Q2 FY2025, ended May 3, 2025) revenue $2,640M. (983/2,640 = +37.2%)
- **Microchip Technology** — Fiscal Q1 2027: net sales $1,484.7M; GAAP gross profit $938.9M (63.2%); GAAP operating income $336.8M (22.7%). Year-ago (Q1 FY2026, ended June 30, 2025) net sales $1,075.5M. (409.2/1,075.5 = +38.0%)
- **NXP Semiconductors** — Q2 2026: revenue $3,496M; GAAP gross profit $2,002M (57.3%); GAAP operating income $1,071M (30.6%). Year-ago (Q2 2025, ended June 29, 2025) revenue $2,926M. (570/2,926 = +19.5%)

## Notes on alignment and methodology
- **No calendarization applied.** Each company's own fiscal quarter that ended between April 1 and July 31, 2026 was used: TI and Microchip both ended June 30, 2026; NXP ended June 28, 2026; ADI ended May 2, 2026. These are the natural reported periods, not calendar-shifted.
- **GAAP basis.** All figures are GAAP as reported in each company's earnings press release (and tied to its SEC-filed financial statements). No non-GAAP/adjusted figures are used. Note NXP's Q1 2026 GAAP operating margin was distorted by a one-time $627M divestiture gain, but that is not the quarter used here; its Q2 2026 GAAP operating income of $1,071M is clean.
- **Margins** are computed as gross profit ÷ revenue and GAAP operating income ÷ revenue.
- Sources as of the filing/release dates: TI Q2 2026 release (investor.ti.com), ADI Q2 FY2026 release/10-Q (investor.analog.com), Microchip Q1 FY2027 release (ir.microchip.com), NXP Q2 2026 release (investors.nxp.com).

One point worth flagging: because the rule forbids calendarizing, this table is **not** a perfectly contemporaneous comparison — ADI's quarter (ended May 2, 2026) sits roughly two months earlier than the others, so it captures a slightly different point in the cycle. Read across the columns as "each company's own spring/early-summer 2026 quarter," not as a synchronized one-quarter snapshot.
